parsed.summary: The patch resolves the issue of temporal subtraction without ExpressionWrapper but introduces a potential compatibility break.

issues.description: The change modifies the behavior of CombinedExpression to allow subtraction between different datetime fields, which may break existing code that relies on the previous stricter type checking.
